articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin posts tentative gains as rates drop ahead of Friday's jobs report
articles.snippet: The euro is losing ground versus the greenback as spiking French bond yields revive memories of the European sovereign debt crisis.

articles.title: Citigroup raises 12-month bitcoin target to $113,000 as ETF inflows resume
articles.snippet: Citi also raised its 12-month target for ether from from $2,240 to $3,028.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin closing out best quarter since 2024, ether its best since 2021
articles.snippet: Crypto prices rose early Wednesday after better-than-forecast inflation data, but gave up those gains as interest rates continued to surge.

articles.title: Trump to host 3rd ‘exclusive’ memecoin event amid corruption claims
articles.snippet: The president is scheduled to appear at his golf club in Washington, DC, at a Nov. 22 dinner for his top 185 memecoin holders, following similar events in May 2025 and April 2026.

articles.title: New York, Wyoming regulators sign pact to coordinate crypto oversight
articles.snippet: The agreement will allow the two state regulators to share supervisory information, streamline licensing reviews and coordinate examinations and enforcement actions involving digital asset firms.
